prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Make one heritage atlas plate. IMAGE 1 is ONLY the Longmen thin-black-line STYLE master; following photographs determine this subject's geometry, NOT their scene. Draw fine sparse BLACK contours, deliberately simplified joints, a few selected roof/stone detail lines. Every non-ink pixel inside and outside the object is perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. No filled black shadows, grayscale, hatching, color, paper grain, gradient, glow, checkerboard, frame, caption, watermark or lettering. Plaques remain blank. Remove tourists, modern fences, cables, trees, sky, paving, other buildings and all ground shadows. Full uncut subject, apex and own base intact, centered with at least 8% clear margins. This is a faithful present-object illustration, not a speculative reconstruction.

Harbin Saint Sophia Cathedral, ACTUAL BRICK building completed1932, not the ice sculpture named Sophia or Istanbul cathedral. Use PHOTO2 full present architecture, PHOTO3 only close-up geometry and material detail. Low shallow three-quarter from front-left, vertical walls vertical, don't over-distort. Preserve large central bulbous ONION DOME over a tall broad cylindrical drum, left front bell tower with tall conical roof and SMALL gilded onion finial, right lower lateral tower with conical roof and small onion finial. All proper orthodox crosses with slanted lower bars belong to building, not lettering. Present complex red-brick round arches, tall arched windows and brick cornice galleries, monumental arched front doorway. Full connected church body and its own low footing, no generic western twin spires, modern white/redroof ticket annex, balloons, foliage, tourists, background, reconstruction of hidden wings or groundshadow. Entire dome crosses and base uncut, centered portrait1024x1536 height82%. Very sparse thin BLACK contours, simplify brick joints to selected detail rather than uniform tiny rectangles.
